mandate: Phase 4 - decide what the synthetic world must gain before Phase 3 can freeze tests. Written before any implementation, as the mandate requires: 'Any extension must be prospective and documented before testing the JEPA against it.'
GOVERNING_DESIGN_RULE: every new component carries a DESIGNED recoverability class written here, before implementation, and a MEASURED oracle ceiling computed after implementation and before any JEPA sees the world. A component whose measured class contradicts its designed class is a construction failure and is repaired or withdrawn, never reinterpreted.
SECOND_RULE_NEW_FILES_ONLY: Worlds B, C and D are NEW generator files. World A's generators are frozen by the lock and must not gain flags, branches or parameters.

RECONCILED_DIVERGENCE_BETWEEN_THE_TWO_IN.owner_instruction: three worlds B/C/D; 'Spatial/SCENIC+/causal perturbation should be added only if required for a specific qualification claim; don't build a kitchen-sink simulator.'
RECONCILED_DIVERGENCE_BETWEEN_THE_TWO_IN.review_lane_instruction: isolate each regime one at a time, and treat SCENIC+-like truth, richer perturbations and spatial biology as required before Phase 3 is finalised
RECONCILED_DIVERGENCE_BETWEEN_THE_TWO_IN.the_tension: minimal world count versus per-regime isolation, and conditional versus mandatory scope
resolution_adopted: world COUNT follows the owner: three worlds, B, C and D. A fourth, E, exists only as a conditional stub.

per-regime ISOLATION follows the review lane, achieved WITHOUT extra worlds: every component below draws from its own orthogonal RNG stream and carries an independent on/off switch, so any single regime can be instantiated alone. Isolation is a property of the component, not of the world.

SCOPE follows the owner: spatial and rich causal perturbation are DEFERRED, but each is bound here to the exact qualification claim that would require it, so the deferral is an explicit decision rather than an omission.
directed regulator->target structure is NOT deferred, because the owner's own World D bullet requires 'explicit regulatory structure rather than shared linear loadings.'
RECONCILED_DIVERGENCE_BETWEEN_THE_TWO_IN.dissent_preserved: the review lane would build spatial and full perturbation truth now. That position is recorded, not adopted. If a spatial or causal claim is later made, World E is required first.

WORLD_B_HETEROGENEOUS_BIOLOGY.purpose: supply the biological heterogeneity World A has none of

components.mechanism: K=6 discrete states by categorical draw on an orthogonal stream; each state carries its own dense program loading vector added to the log-relative rate
a 3-dim latent drawn per DONOR index and shared by every cell of that donor, added to the cell's log-relative rate. Drawn on a stream keyed by donor, never by operator
components.closes_premise_gap: donor biology was ABSENT with ICC at the independence null

components.component: rare states, designed on both sides of the recoverability line
components.mechanism: four low-prevalence subpopulations at prevalences 0.05, 0.01, 0.002 and 0.0005. Two carry a program on genes that are available under most operators (recoverable); two carry a program on genes that are structurally unavailable under most operators (non-recoverable from the permitted view)
components.target_oracle_ceiling_from_permitted_RNA: detection AP, not R2: recoverable arm designed well above the prevalence base rate, non-recoverable arm designed at the base rate
components.isolable_by: B3 alone, and each prevalence separately
components.closes_premise_gap: rare biology was ABSENT; tails were exactly Gaussian, so rare-state sensitivity could not be tested at all

components.mechanism: a continuous pseudotime per cell plus a program whose loading is a smooth unimodal function of pseudotime, so the effect exists only in a middle band
programs loading on 3 to 8 genes only, with large per-gene effect and small total transcriptome weight, so they are biologically salient but do not dominate library composition
components.closes_premise_gap: all World A loadings are dense; no marker structure existed

components.mechanism: a graded family of five factors. Factor j splits its loading between genes measured under essentially all operators and genes unavailable under a controlled fraction of operators, with the mixing fraction stepped across the family
components.closes_premise_gap: World A is sharply bimodal - every factor is about 0.67 recoverable or exactly 0.00 - so it contains NO partially recoverable case and cannot calibrate a partial-recoverability metric. This is the single most important gap for the premise question.

WORLD_B_HETEROGENEOUS_BIOLOGY.shared_substrate: World A's population geometry, QC calibration and observation operator are reused unchanged

WORLD_C_STRUCTURED_BIOLOGY.purpose: supply structure that a global linear coordinate cannot absorb

components.mechanism: states A and B each carry their own program; their CO-occurrence additionally activates a third, disjoint gene module. The interaction module is driven by the product term and loads on genes used by neither parent program
components.target_oracle_ceiling_from_permitted_RNA: linear oracle designed near 0.05-0.15; nonlinear oracle designed 0.45-0.65
components.closes_premise_gap: World A is linear in the latents, so no model can be credited or penalised for capturing interaction. The gap between the linear and nonlinear ceilings is the whole measurement

components.mechanism: a per-cell multiplicative GAIN applied to one specific gene module's loading vector, rather than an additive global coordinate. The effect changes the relationship between a module and the state instead of shifting the cell's position
components.target_oracle_ceiling_from_permitted_RNA: global-readout oracle designed near 0.00-0.10; module-conditional oracle designed 0.40-0.60
components.closes_premise_gap: World A's z_query is named local but passes through the same global linear map, so it is an RNA-private GLOBAL factor. A true local effect must be invisible to a global linear readout and visible to a module-conditional one

components.mechanism: per-gene availability probability and cell library complexity are made to depend jointly on operator AND cell state - for example cells in one state have systematically reduced complexity, and one program raises dropout within its own genes
components.target_oracle_ceiling_from_permitted_RNA: not a ceiling; the deliverable is a measurable confounding magnitude
components.isolable_by: C3 alone, with a C3-off twin
components.closes_premise_gap: measured in World A at |corr| <= 0.0086, i.e. independent by construction. The mandate explicitly says not to assume the observation operator is independent of biological state, and World A currently cannot test it at all

WORLD_C_STRUCTURED_BIOLOGY.mandatory_twin: every World C instance ships with a C-off twin at identical seeds so the structured effect is measured as a difference, not as a level

WORLD_D_REGULATORY_MULTIMODAL.purpose: replace shared linear loadings with directed regulation, and repair defect D2
closes: regulatory relationships as mechanism rather than latent sharing
the biological versus technical ATAC-private degeneracy

components.component: directed regulator -> region -> target gene structure
components.mechanism: a set of regulators; each regulator is assigned a SPARSE set of bound ATAC regions and a sparse set of target genes. Regulator activity raises accessibility at its bound regions and, through a directed signed coefficient, raises or lowers its target genes. Non-bound regions and non-target genes are explicit known negatives
components.designed_recoverability_class: RECOVERABLE_AS_A_GRAPH, with known positives and known negatives
components.target_oracle_ceiling_from_permitted_RNA: region-to-gene link precision and recall against the planted graph
components.closes_premise_gap: World A has no transcription factor, motif or peak-to-gene link. Its ATAC regions are a uniform 5 kb tiling of chr1 and its loading matrix is dense random, so no cis-regulatory question is even expressible

components.mechanism: biological ATAC-private regulation acts through D1's directed graph: SPARSE, structured region loadings that are statistically linked to specific target genes. Technical ATAC-private variation acts on measurement properties: DENSE and near-uniform across regions, correlated with fragment depth and operator QC, and carrying no region-to-gene structure
components.target_oracle_ceiling_from_permitted_RNA: the deliverable is a separation statistic, not a ceiling
components.isolable_by: D2 alone, and jointly with D1
components.closes_premise_gap: in World A, technical_latents[0] and z_reg_private both score 0.000 from RNA and about 0.85 from ATAC. They are structurally identical, so no cross-modal biological-meaning claim is possible. This repair is mandatory before any such claim

WORLD_D_REGULATORY_MULTIMODAL.scope_limit: D1 supplies TF-like regulator to region to gene TRUTH with known positives and negatives. It does NOT build cisTarget databases, motif rankings or the SCENIC+ software path - those are an inference pipeline, not ground truth, and are out of scope here

contents_if_ever_required: multi-target perturbations with dose, direct effects, downstream cascades and null perturbations

exact_claims_that_would_require_it.spatial: any claim that the representation preserves microenvironment or niche context
exact_claims_that_would_require_it.causal_perturbation: any claim that the representation supports CAUSAL prediction. The Oct-5 reset already holds causal qualification as a separate level, so this is not on the current critical path

WORLD_E_CONDITIONAL_NOT_BUILT.rule: if either claim is proposed, World E is a prerequisite and must be built and measured first

ORDER_OF_OPERATIONS: 1. DONE - World A locked, including its generator blob digests and behavioural signatures
2. DONE - repair R1 applied at the metric level; denominators use 11 biological dimensions, not 14
3. THIS ARTIFACT - B/C/D designed prospectively with recoverability classes, before implementation
4. NEXT - implement B, C and D as new generator files; World A generators remain untouched
5. NEXT - measure the oracle ceiling of every component and compare it against its designed class
6. ONLY THEN - Phase 3 freezes the qualification tests across all four worlds
7. AFTER THAT - train and evaluate, judged as fraction of RECOVERABLE truth
WHAT_PHASE_4_DELIBERATELY_DOES_NOT_DO: it does not implement anything yet; the design is frozen first so the tests cannot be fitted to it
it does not mutate World A
it does not build a kitchen-sink simulator
it does not define the Phase 3 metrics; those are frozen only after the ceilings are measured
